name: policy-rule-agent

dependencies.name: expense-api
dependencies.description: Reads the active policy rules for context and creates or updates the rule the plain-language description parses to.

description: Turns a Finance/Admin's plain-language description of a spending policy rule (e.g. "cap meals at 25,000 LKR a month") into a structured policy rule and saves it via expense-api. It does not decide claims, does not read claims, and only ever writes to policy-rules — never to claims or decisions.
